nodes.label: REFRIGER CHARGING MACHINE — PLC Standard Program Design Report
Input/Output Map — Physical I/O to Internal Logic Mapping
REF Project — GX Works2 PLC IL CSV Processing
REFRIGER Charging Machine PLC Program Structure
Wrapped TSV Quoting Model
nodes.rationale: GX-Works2 emits non-standard wrapped-TSV: outer quote wrapping, inner doubled quotes, first field bare. Root cause of broken round-trips if misunderstood.

nodes.label: IL Row Types (Type A/B/C)
nodes.rationale: Type A=label, Type B=instruction head with step, Type C=continuation with extra operand. Critical for correct parse/generate.

nodes.label: Rung Composition Rules
nodes.rationale: Each rung: exactly one load (LD/LDI/LDP/LDF), then series/parallel conditions, then outputs. MPS/MPP paired. ANB/ORB are block connectors, not rung starts.

nodes.label: Device Address Notation Rules
nodes.rationale: M/L hex in docs→decimal in CSV. X/Y=UPPER hex. D/T/K=decimal. U<n>\G<addr> for intelligent buffer. K/H/E constants without zero-padding.

nodes.label: Verified IL Coding Rules (REF Project)
nodes.rationale: Timer=OUT not TMR. Avoid CJ in IL CSV. Note column must be empty. M/L hex→decimal. Max 8 outputs per rung. Device comment CSV header='AAAA'.

nodes.label: POU Module Structure
nodes.rationale: 11 POUs: idata (init/mapping), gmes (PC comm), MAIN (mode/step), setting (config), gunvac/unitvac/vacchec/refinj (process), alarm, ad, 485, spc (stats). Always ON or step-triggered.

nodes.label: L/M/D/X/Y Device Allocation Strategy
nodes.rationale: L=retentive latch bits. M=volatile step/coil/DI mirror. D0-D299=retentive params (even-addr for 32-bit). X/Y via mapping files, never direct reference in logic.

nodes.label: System Configuration Variations
nodes.rationale: Single program for 1L1G/1L2G/2L2G/2L4G via D228(LineCount), D230(GunPerLine). D234 switches REF Only vs REF+OIL. Gun Index=Line×D230+GunLocal.

nodes.label: HMI-PLC-Field-PC Data Flow Architecture
nodes.rationale: HMI writes M400-M416 (momentary→self-hold/toggle), reads D0-D107. PC writes D180-D189/D230-D249. X→M via idata, M→Y via output mapping. Cycle-done clears PC write area.

nodes.label: Safety PLC Interface Protocol
nodes.rationale: Safety PLC monitors E-stop independently. Main runs only when SafetyOK(M30B=X0B) ON. Reset handshake: M50→Y1C. L40(EMG Stop)=global stop.

nodes.label: Analog Input Scaling (ad.csv)
nodes.rationale: Per-line Pressure/Temperature/Vacuum scaling: DMOV raw→D*scale→D/divisor→EU register. Moving average or 1st-order lag filter before EU update.

nodes.label: Line Independence Principle
nodes.rationale: Shared latches L42-L4A mixed L0 and L1 sources, causing cross-line blocking. Per-line latch separation required for true independent operation.

nodes.label: Per-Line Alarm Latch Design
nodes.rationale: L42-L4A kept for L0 (GunVac/UnitVac/VacLeak/Inj/Pressure/Temp). L70-L78 allocated for L1. Per-line ALARM RESET: M403(L0), M405(L1). Single shared buzzer Y30.

nodes.label: GMES Result Code Mapping
nodes.rationale: D7012(L0)/D8012(L1) stores result codes: 1=OK, 2=VacuumNG, 3=GunVacNG, 4=UnitVacNG, 5=VacCheckNG, 6=OperatorStop, 7=NoneFlow, 8=TimeOver, 9=BackFlow, 10=DataNotMatch, 11=RecvTimeOver.

nodes.label: Manual Mode Select→START Pattern
nodes.rationale: Changed from direct-execute to select→START: function buttons set M420-M423, START reads selection and sets corresponding step bit, then clears selection.

nodes.label: Gun Type (1-Sol Base / H+L Fast+Normal)
nodes.rationale: Type 0=Base 1-Sol, Type 1=H+L(Fast+Normal) 2-Sol. Gun Type per D32/D46/D60/D74. Oil mirrors same solenoid structure when D234=1.

nodes.label: Oil Mode (REF Only / REF+OIL)
nodes.rationale: D234=0: REF Only (VacCheck→Refrig→Exhaust→Complete). D234=1: REF+OIL (VacCheck→Oil→Refrig→Exhaust→Complete). Oil uses same gun type solenoid structure.

nodes.label: Process Step Sequence
nodes.rationale: Auto: IDLE→PRECHECK→GUN VAC→UNIT VAC→VAC CHECK→[OIL INJ]→REFRIG INJ→EXHAUST→COMPLETE. Manual: select function then START, runs one step only.

nodes.label: Injection Source (Barcode PC / Local Model)
nodes.rationale: Barcode (PC) mode: PC writes amount to D-register, system matches preset table for Model#. Local mode: user inputs Model# directly, looks up preset injection amount.

nodes.label: Reset Types (Hard / Soft)
nodes.rationale: Hard Reset=physical RESET push button. Soft Reset=HMI screen RESET button. Both return system to IDLE state.
